en: A monochrome/sepia postcard view of a long, ornate brick military barracks complex behind a tall fence and gate. The architecture is late‑19th‑century German style with gabled roofs, decorative brickwork, and tall chimneys. Two uniformed soldiers or guards stand at the entrance gate in the foreground. At the top, red printed text reads "2. K. S. Pionier-Bataillon No. 22. Kaserne."
